description:
Immerse yourself in the luxury of our expansive home, boasting 2500 square feet of living space and a charming balcony! Nestled in a central location, you'll be surrounded by the heartbeat of live music, culinary delights, and lively entertainment. A 6-minute Uber ride conveniently connects you to downtown. It is just 1.5 miles from Titans stadium and 2 miles from the iconic Broadway. Permit #2019017225

The space
Indulge in the comfort of our multi-level residence, designed to accommodate large groups and families with abundant sleeping arrangements. The well-appointed rooftop terrace is a standout feature, providing an ideal spot for relaxation and quality time with friends or family. The kitchen has state-of-the-art appliances, essential cooking supplies, dishes, and a convenient coffee maker. The bright and inviting living room features a generously sized floating Smart TV. The open floor plan seamlessly connects to a lively common space, offering the perfect setting for your group to gather during your stay. Centrally located in a secure and vibrant neighborhood, you'll find it easy to walk to various attractions. Enjoy the benefits of a modern kitchen, a private rooftop, the trendy Nashville locale, professional design, proximity to great spots, YouTube TV for live streaming, and TVs in each bedroom and the living room.

Guest access
Access to the entire home
